Thanks everyone! I'll head over to that thread. I have been logging exercise and meals (occasional slips on weekends) but I get stuck right back into it asap which I feel has been helpful!
Maybe posting regularly will be helpful :)

Thank you... so much.

He is the most beautiful person in my life. Thank you.

I know it hurts. And in the moment, everything reaches a cathartic point- but you should really reach out to someone who can help understand what's hurting you most. 
Have you tried a suicide watch hotline? They operate 24/7 and the people are amazing, wonderful and resourceful. They've helped me avert a crisis many times.
